dialogues.speaker: Pyrrho
dialogues.text: This is no place for you. Please, go back.

dialogues.speaker: Pyrrho
dialogues.text: Though Lady Sorush speaks for you, I will not be so lenient should you make any suspicious movements!

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: Hmph. Of course. I am one of the oldest qualified members of our Order, after all.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: I am not quite the equal of our Vijnanapati, but as one of the desertfolk who have lived here for generations, the Order and I are as one by blood.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: So if you encounter any issues, you can ask...

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: No, wait! No. I won't be answering any of your questions!

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: He's a very knowledgeable scholar! He knows more than anyone I've ever met.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: We Skeptics were once a Darshan within the Akademiya, but our traditions of knowledge have been eroded after hundreds of years here in the desert, far from the city.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: It's all thanks to our Vijnanapati that we are recovering our ancient traditions. With him around, our Order shall soon reclaim our lost glory!

choices.text: Don't worry, you shan't hear questions from me.

dialogues.speaker: Pyrrho
dialogues.text: To think that something like this would happen. What a disgrace...

dialogues.speaker: Pyrrho
dialogues.text: As I thought, stuff regarding knowledge doesn't really suit me all that much. Too complicated.

choices.text: Tell me about the Order of Skeptics...

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: Our top priority is choosing a new Vijnanapati, but as you can see, we do not have anyone who can currently fill that role.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: However, we have already asked Elder Aryadeva to invite an exceptional researcher to come over from the city.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: We have stood sentinel here these hundreds of years, and we have seen many a crisis through in our time. This is but a small problem. Don't worry about us!

choices.text: Not going over to the camp?

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: All the more I should stand guard here at a time like this. If some ill-intentioned villains sneak in, things might really get bad.

response.speaker: Pyrrho
response.text: Even Miss Sosi told me not to go running around. She must rely on me quite a bit, I think.

choices.text: I'll leave you to it, then.
